info.brief: Functions and constants for interacting with bridge
info.description: Functions and constants for interacting with bridge

elements.name: bridge.platform.on
elements.description: State changed events.

elements.name: bridge.platform.id
elements.description: Identify the platform on which the game is currently running to customize features and settings accordingly.

elements.name: bridge.platform.tld
elements.description: Retrieve the top-level domain of the platform to handle domain-specific configurations and behavior.

elements.name: bridge.platform.language
elements.description: Get the language set by the user on the platform or the browser language if not provided by the platform, to localize game content.

elements.name: bridge.platform.payload
elements.description: Embed auxiliary information into the game URL to pass additional data or settings when launching the game.

elements.name: bridge.platform.send_message
elements.description: Send predefined messages to the platform to trigger specific actions or events, such as signaling that the game is ready.

elements.name: bridge.platform.send_custom_message
elements.description: Send a custom message with an arbitrary id to the platform.

elements.name: bridge.platform.get_server_time
elements.description: Server Time

elements.name: bridge.platform.is_audio_enabled
elements.description: Check if the audio is enabled on the platform.

elements.name: bridge.platform.is_external_calls_supported
elements.description: Check if external calls are supported on the platform.

elements.name: bridge.platform.is_external_links_allowed
elements.description: Check if external links are allowed on the platform.

elements.name: bridge.cross_promo.get_games
elements.description: Get the cross-promo games list. Resolves to an empty array when unsupported. Each game has the shape { id, name, url, icon_url, cover_url, payload }.

elements.name: bridge.cross_promo.show
elements.description: Show the built-in cross-promo HTML overlay.

elements.name: bridge.cross_promo.hide
elements.description: Hide the built-in cross-promo HTML overlay.

elements.name: bridge.cross_promo.is_visible
elements.description: Check whether the cross-promo overlay is currently shown.

elements.name: bridge.storage.get
elements.description: Retrieve stored data based on a key or multiple keys to restore player progress or settings.

elements.name: bridge.storage.set
elements.description: Save data to the storage with a key to retain player progress or settings.

elements.name: bridge.storage.delete
elements.description: Remove data from the storage by key to manage player data and settings effectively.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.show_banner
elements.description: Display a banner ad within your game to generate revenue through advertising.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.hide_banner
elements.description: Hide the currently displayed banner ad when it is no longer needed.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.banner_state
elements.description: Hide the currently displayed banner ad when it is no longer needed.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.is_banner_supported
elements.description: Check if the platform supports displaying banner ads. Use this to determine if you can include banner advertisements in your game.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.is_interstitial_supported
elements.description: Check if the platform supports displaying interstitial ads. Use this to determine if you can include interstitial advertisements in your game.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.is_rewarded_supported
elements.description: Check if the platform supports displaying rewarded ads. Use this to determine if you can include rewarded advertisements in your game.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.on
elements.description: State changed events.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.show_interstitial
elements.description: Display an interstitial ad at appropriate moments, such as during level transitions or game over screens.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.interstitial_state
elements.description: Track the state of the interstitial ad to manage ad display and user experience.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.minimum_delay_between_interstitial
elements.description: Minimum time interval between interstitial ad displays to comply with platform requirements and improve user experience.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.set_minimum_delay_between_interstitial
elements.description: Set the minimum time interval between interstitial ad displays to comply with platform requirements and improve user experience.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.rewarded_state
elements.description: Monitor the state of the rewarded ad (loading, opened, closed, rewarded, failed) to manage the reward process.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.rewarded_placement
elements.description: Monitor the placement of the rewarded ad to manage the reward process.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.show_rewarded
elements.description: Display a rewarded ad and provide incentives to players for watching the entire ad.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.is_advanced_banners_supported
elements.description: Check if the platform supports displaying advanced banner ads.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.advanced_banners_state
elements.description: Track the state of the advanced banners to manage ad display and user experience.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.show_advanced_banners
elements.description: Display advanced banners at appropriate moments of the game.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.hide_advanced_banners
elements.description: Hide the currently displayed advanced banners when they are no longer needed.

elements.name: bridge.advertisement.check_ad_block
elements.description: Check if the ad blocker is enabled.

elements.name: bridge.device.type
elements.description: Determine the type of device (mobile, tablet, desktop, tv) the game is being played on to adjust the game`s interface and performance settings.

elements.name: bridge.player.is_authorization_supported
elements.description: Check if the platform supports player authorization to enable features that require user authentication, such as saving game progress or accessing social features.

elements.name: bridge.player.is_authorized
elements.description: Verify if the player is currently authorized on the platform. This allows you to enable personalized features, such as saving high scores or providing user-specific content.

elements.name: bridge.player.is_guest
elements.description: Check if the player is unauthorized or running as a guest.

elements.name: bridge.player.id
elements.description: Get the player’s unique ID on the platform to manage user-specific data and settings. Use this ID to track player progress, achievements, and purchases.

elements.name: bridge.player.name
elements.description: Retrieve the player's name to personalize the game experience. Display the name in leaderboards, friend lists, or when sending notifications and messages.

elements.name: bridge.player.extra
elements.description: Get the extra information about player.

elements.name: bridge.player.photos
elements.description: Get the count of player avatars available. Use this to manage and display user profile images effectively, such as showing the avatar in multiplayer lobbies or profile screens.

elements.name: bridge.player.authorize
elements.description: Authorize the player on the platform to access protected features and personalize the game experience. For example, prompting the player to log in to save their progress or unlock social sharing features.

elements.name: bridge.social.is_share_supported
elements.description: Check if the share functionality is supported on the platform.

elements.name: bridge.social.share
elements.description: Use this to allow players to share game content or achievements on social media platforms.

elements.name: bridge.social.is_join_community_supported
elements.description: Check if the join community functionality is supported on the platform.

elements.name: bridge.social.join_community
elements.description: Use this to allow players to share game content or achievements on social media platforms.

elements.name: bridge.social.is_invite_friends_supported
elements.description: Check if the invite friends functionality is supported on the platform.

elements.name: bridge.social.invite_friends
elements.description: Allow players to invite their friends to play the game, helping to grow your player base organically.

elements.name: bridge.social.is_create_post_supported
elements.description: Check if the create post functionality is supported on the platform.

elements.name: bridge.social.create_post
elements.description: Use this to let players create posts about their achievements or updates directly from the game.

elements.name: bridge.social.is_add_to_favorites_supported
elements.description: Check if the add to favorites functionality is supported on the platform.

elements.name: bridge.social.add_to_favorites
elements.description: Allow players to bookmark your game for easy access in the future.

elements.name: bridge.social.is_add_to_home_screen_supported
elements.description: Check if the add to home screen functionality is supported on the platform.

elements.name: bridge.social.add_to_home_screen
elements.description: Enable players to add a shortcut to your game on their home screen for quick access.

elements.name: bridge.social.is_rate_supported
elements.description: Check if the rate game functionality is supported on the platform.

elements.name: bridge.social.rate
elements.description: Encourage players to rate your game, providing valuable feedback and improving visibility.

elements.name: bridge.payments.is_supported
elements.description: Check if in-game purchases are supported to offer items or upgrades within the game.

elements.name: bridge.payments.purchase
elements.description: Allow players to buy items or upgrades in your game to enhance their gameplay experience.

elements.name: bridge.payments.consume_purchase
elements.description: Consume purchased items, such as in-game currency, once they are used, to manage inventory and player progression.

elements.name: bridge.payments.get_catalog
elements.description: Retrieve a list of all available in-game items that players can purchase to display in the game store.

elements.name: bridge.payments.get_purchases
elements.description: Retrieve a list of items that the player has purchased to manage their inventory and provide access to purchased content.

elements.name: bridge.achievements.unlock
elements.description: Unlocks achievement for a player.

elements.name: bridge.achievements.get_achievements
elements.description: Returns the achievement list in JSON.

elements.name: bridge.daily_rewards.get_rewards
elements.description: Returns the configured ordered list of reward ids as a JSON string.

elements.name: bridge.daily_rewards.get_current_day
elements.description: Returns the 0-based index of the reward the player is currently on.

elements.name: bridge.daily_rewards.get_current_reward
elements.description: Returns the id of the reward claimable today, or nil when nothing can be claimed.

elements.name: bridge.daily_rewards.claim_current_reward
elements.description: Claims the reward available today. Calls on_success when claimed, on_failure otherwise.

elements.name: bridge.tasks.get_tasks
elements.description: Returns every active task across all groups, with live progress, as a JSON string.

elements.name: bridge.tasks.add_progress
elements.description: Advances every active target whose id equals the given metric, clamped to the target amount.

elements.name: bridge.tasks.claim_reward
elements.description: Claims a completed task's rewards. Calls on_success with true when claimed, false otherwise.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.doc: The id of the task to claim.

elements.name: bridge.leaderboards.type
elements.description: Check the leaderboards type on the platform.

elements.name: bridge.leaderboards.set_score
elements.description: Submit the player's score to the leaderboard to update their rank and position.

elements.name: bridge.leaderboards.get_entries
elements.description: Retrieve entries from the leaderboard, including the player's rank and score, to display a comprehensive leaderboard.

elements.name: bridge.leaderboards.show_native_popup
elements.description: Show native popup leaderboard.

elements.name: bridge.remote_config.is_supported
elements.description: Check if remote configuration is supported to manage game settings without releasing updates.

elements.name: bridge.remote_config.set_context
elements.description: Set dynamic game/player parameters used for config segmentation. Accumulates across calls; only used by platforms that support it.

elements.name: bridge.remote_config.get
elements.description: Encourage players to rate your game, providing valuable feedback and improving visibility.
